Her four notes, answered

1THE SHOULDERS (both)

Her note: the arms are tubes laid on the torso with the outline running across the join. Each upper arm must grow out of the body as one silhouette: no outline across the shoulder, no notch at the neck side of the propping arm, the round of the shoulder flowing into the chest.

THE PROPPING SHOULDER
THE NEAR SHOULDER

The propping arm now belongs to the body's own silhouette: one round at the shoulder, the line from under the chin runs onto it and on down the arm with no break, the armpit the only crease. The near shoulder is the chest's own round, the arm's outer edge is the front of the torso down to the elbow, and inside the chest nothing crosses the join: the one line is the arm's inner edge, starting at the armpit.

2THE WRISTS (both hands)

Her note: the hand on the knee and the propping hand meet the forearm as a blunt tube end with a seam. Taper the forearm into the wrist and let the palm widen out of it in one shape, no line across the wrist.

THE HAND ON THE KNEE
THE PROPPING HAND

Forearm, wrist and palm are one shape now: the forearm narrows into the wrist, the wrist bends on a round, and the palm widens out of it to the knuckles. The fingers hang from the knuckle line as before.

3THE ANKLES (both feet)

Her note: the feet are pasted onto the shin ends (a straight cut and a seam). The shin must narrow into the ankle and the foot grow out of it in one silhouette; the far foot, tipped up, bends at the ankle, not at a cut.

THE NEAR ANKLE
THE FAR ANKLE

Shin, ankle and foot are one shape: the shin narrows into the ankle, the ankle bends on a round with a soft heel on the outside of the bend, and the foot widens out of it to the toes. The far foot tips up by bending at its ankle.

4THE BELLY

Her note: the cream belly is a detached tilted oval with stripe lines, off-centre and cut by the arm. It should be the front of her torso: centred on the chest/belly line, following the lean of the body from under the chin down between the thighs, widest at the tummy, soft edge, no stripes.

THE BELLY

One cream lens on the front of her torso: it starts under the chin, follows the lean of the body down to the crotch between the thighs, is widest at the tummy, keeps a green margin inside the back's outline, and runs beside the near arm's inner line rather than under it. Soft edge, no outline, no stripes.
